body: 076 recorded as conditional planning evidence; amended completion and test readiness are not established. All 4 report and 9 source pins match. The required Hoff-Mautner half-wavelength evaluation from ord-admiral-rr2-mainline076-add-half-wavelength-1022 is absent: no wavelength result or cited evaluation, only the prior handbook-absence statement. Transfer therefore stays open. R4.1547/R5.9508 m articles hold three groups, not cell count or demonstrated imperfection similarity; they are not established smallest transferring shells. T3's proposed pass ranges admit Q=0.32 and factor=0.7737, below design assumptions 0.33/0.7937. They may describe measurement agreement but do not demonstrate the assumed lower allowables; uncertainty/confidence treatment and conservative acceptance remain unresolved. Three deliberately different shells do not establish same-condition scatter. Collapse pressures are isothermal, omit cure/gradient/bending and retain the sig0-power discrepancy; nominal sea-level headroom is not demonstrated facility capability. Catalog gauge/tolerance ranges do not establish current buildability. Loading rate, demonstrated instrumentation, applicable prices and facility availability remain open. The 205x elastic dimpling estimate does not alone exclude observed cell-scale failure. No supplier contact, purchase or independent science rerun. V10 and conditional targets unchanged.
